validation: 379 distinct focused tests pass; actual Metal/Gurobi. No NVIDIA execution.
limits: All jobs serialized under shared fcntl lock; waiting excluded.
Production walls time sim.run with small iteration callback; validation walls also include per-flight extra audits and repeated growing JSON writes.
Profiled walls are instrumented, not performance baselines; cProfile owner only, worker stages measured separately.
GPU and CPU have same input/domain/solver parameters except backend-related options. Different column trajectories, final costs and round counts prevent an equal-result speedup claim.
Native CPU benchmark uses current main descendant of PR133, not an exact PR133 checkout.
Stage timings overlap; worker CPU/account sums are not elapsed time. RSS highwaters are not simultaneous aggregate memory.
All runs stop at configured LP-gap criterion; global integer gap remains nonzero.
All GPU runs retain full-CPU fallback/numeric-verification guards and production canonical route validation; workers cannot initialize GPU.
